newsitem.title: USA: Handwriting of JonBenet's mother probed - report.
newsitem.headline: Handwriting of JonBenet's mother probed - report.

text.p: Features on some characters of handwriting samples provided by the mother of murdered child beauty pageant winner JonBenet Ramsey resemble the writing in a ransom note found at the family's home, a newspaper reported Wednesday.
But the Rocky Mountain News quoted sources as saying that police had not concluded that Patricia Ramsey wrote the ransom note.

The note demanding $118,000 for the safe return of 6-year-old JonBenet was found by Patricia Ramsey early Dec. 26 when she came downstairs to make coffee at the family's Boulder home. The child's body was found in the basement by her father John Ramsey about eight hours later.
Boulder officials were not available to comment on the newspaper report. Police have disclosed few details of the probe.

The newspaper quoted Ramsey family spokesman Pat Korten as saying that no family member wrote the ramson note and handwriting experts hired by the family concluded that neither John nor Patricia Ramsey wrote the note.
Police have said they asked the mother to provide a third handwriting sample and earlier samples were not suitable because she was under medication.
